name: verify_productTemplateUomUomRel_links_ordered
note: root junction product_template_uom_uom_rel: every link as the ORM's Many2many.read sees it, ordered by both ids
source_sql: SELECT product_template_id, uom_uom_id FROM product_template_uom_uom_rel ORDER BY product_template_id, uom_uom_id

name: verify_productTemplateUomUomRel_links_per_product_template_id
note: root junction product_template_uom_uom_rel: link count per product_template_id (the owning side's record set size)
source_sql: SELECT product_template_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_template_uom_uom_rel GROUP BY product_template_id ORDER BY product_template_id
